current_tested_api_surface.interpretation: This is a deterministic mechanism-core API, not an optimizer API.

method_section_traceability.title: Input, output and scope
method_section_traceability.present: Problem equation and intended output are specified in prose.
method_section_traceability.missing_for_complete_algorithm: No problem/evaluator protocol, optimizer result object, best-solution contract or complete diagnostic output API.

method_section_traceability.title: Evaluation and violation contract
method_section_traceability.present: EvaluationLedger and EvaluationCache red contracts exist.
method_section_traceability.missing_for_complete_algorithm: No equality-tolerance implementation, aggregate violation comparator, feasible/infeasible lexicographic selection or stable-ID tie-break contract.

method_section_traceability.title: Rolling evidence window
method_section_traceability.present: Positive rescaling invariance of normalized profiles is tested.
method_section_traceability.missing_for_complete_algorithm: No 5N rolling history container, n_min gate, duplicate/cached record policy, positive quantile scale update or archive re-profiling state.

method_section_traceability.title: Shrinkage co-violation graph
method_section_traceability.present: Known-block edges, row permutation, positive rescaling, empty graph and finite-weight behavior have red contracts.
method_section_traceability.missing_for_complete_algorithm: No boundary tests for prevalence 0.05/0.95, shrinkage and edge threshold equality, undefined phi, complete graph or arbitrary deterministic component ordering.

method_section_traceability.title: Stability and activation gate
method_section_traceability.present: weighted_jaccard arithmetic and one low-constraint fallback exist.
method_section_traceability.missing_for_complete_algorithm: build_covio_graph accepts no previous graph or online state; there is no activation-controller API, fallback-precedence contract or tests for six declared reasons.

method_section_traceability.title: Community profiles
method_section_traceability.missing_for_complete_algorithm: No component-profile aggregation, dominant-component smallest-ID tie break or FEASIBLE_TARGET behavior test.

method_section_traceability.title: Graph-conditioned ordered donor pair
method_section_traceability.present: Reciprocal-complement eligibility and signed order are tested for one fixture.
method_section_traceability.missing_for_complete_algorithm: No 30-percent stable quantile boundary, population/archive domain enforcement, full distinct-index rules, uniform graph_rng sampling or NO_VALID_PAIR integration test.

method_section_traceability.title: RNG isolation and exact fallback
method_section_traceability.present: Domain-separated stream independence and exact low-constraint fallback are tested.
method_section_traceability.missing_for_complete_algorithm: No exact stream-derivation oracle and no parent-trace equivalence across every inactive and NO_VALID_PAIR path.

method_section_traceability.title: Bounds, adaptation and cache
method_section_traceability.missing_for_complete_algorithm: No midpoint repair, SHADE success-history memory, p-best sampling, archive capacity, population schedule, raw-residual retention or current-scale archive re-profiling implementation/tests.

method_section_traceability.title: Frozen candidate defaults
method_section_traceability.present: One GraphConfig fixture sets major graph defaults explicitly.
method_section_traceability.missing_for_complete_algorithm: No single immutable config schema or tests locking every default and rejecting unregistered overrides.

method_section_traceability.title: Complexity and FFE neutrality
method_section_traceability.missing_for_complete_algorithm: No wall-clock, peak-memory, activation/fallback rate, valid-pair count, graph density or stability instrumentation and no complexity evidence bundle.

method_section_traceability.title: Pre-implementation verification contracts
method_section_traceability.present: Eight of ten requirements have direct or fixed-fixture evidence.
method_section_traceability.missing_for_complete_algorithm: Mandatory complete/unstable fallback contracts and multi-path exact fallback are missing; see bound TDD coverage audit.

method_section_traceability.title: Claim boundary and kill criteria
method_section_traceability.present: Thresholds and claim boundaries are frozen in the plan/failure tree.
method_section_traceability.missing_for_complete_algorithm: No runtime guardrail monitor, immutable run bundle, branch-action executor or result-analysis evidence exists.

current_candidate_assessment.forbidden_completion_claim: Passing the current or amended deterministic core tests does not mean the optimizer, experiment system or paper evidence is complete.
